text: Removing the classical rule of double-negation elimination from natural deduction still leaves the law of excluded middle φ ∨ ¬φ provable.
explanation: False. Without double-negation elimination (RAA) one obtains INTUITIONISTIC natural deduction, in which the law of excluded middle φ ∨ ¬φ is not provable (nor is ¬¬φ → φ). It is precisely the classical rule that restores excluded middle.
